name: Emergency Relief Center A (Gajuwaka High School)
purpose: Primary emergency shelter with dry floor, medical triage room, and backup generator.

name: Community Shelter B (Port Indoor Sports Complex)
purpose: Large elevated multi-purpose indoor shelter equipped for overnight stays and relief distribution.

name: Demo Medical Center (Gajuwaka Area Hospital)
purpose: Immediate trauma care, pediatric treatment, hypothermia management, and emergency surgical stabilization.

name: District Referral Trauma Center (KGH Auxiliary)
purpose: Tertiary referral hospital for severe trauma, elderly complications, and specialized surgical care.

name: Demo Ambulance Unit 1 (ALS Rapid 108)
location: Staged at Gajuwaka Junction Point Alpha
purpose: Advanced Life Support (ALS) transport equipped with defibrillator, oxygen, and emergency airway kit.

name: Demo Ambulance Unit 2 (BLS Fleet 108)
location: Staged at Auto Nagar Relief Depot
purpose: Basic Life Support (BLS) rapid evacuation of injured, elderly, and mobility-impaired residents.

name: Demo Rescue Team Alpha (NDRF 10th BN Water Wing)
location: Armed with 4 Inflatable Motor Boats (IRBs) at Kanithi Road
purpose: Evacuation of marooned families, boat rescue in inundated residential zones, rooftop extraction.

name: SDRF Fire & Disaster Quick Response Team 3
availability: En Route to Waterlogged Choke Points
purpose: De-watering flooded basements, clearing fallen trees, tree & power line hazard mitigation.

name: Demo Food Supply Center (Civil Supplies Central Hub)
purpose: High-calorie nutrition packs, baby formula, ready-to-eat meals (upma, poha, biscuits) for displaced victims.

name: Demo Water Supply Center (Municipal Mobile Water Fleet)
location: GVMC Water Depot, Near Old Gajuwaka Tank
capacity: 8 Mobile Water Tankers (40,000 Liters) + 2,000 Chlorine Tablets
availability: Dispatched to Relief Points A & B
purpose: Potable drinking water supply, chlorine disinfectant kits, oral rehydration salts (ORS) distribution.
